en.headline: 6 commits to sopen-translate; 15 automated commits by github-actions[bot]
en.summary: On 2026-10-23 the user made **6 own commits**, all in `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, plus 15 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sopen-translate` work spanned several areas: page performance was reworked with provider-policy batching, bounded concurrency and adaptive splitting; the model cache TTL in options and popup was corrected, with restore status fetching guarded; and an offline-built builtin glossary shipped with 797 entries. Documentation was updated with recorded C6 real-device acceptance results, and the release was bumped to `0.2.0` with docs synced to the bilingual and glossary work. A chore commit added locally installed agent skills to the ignore list. Totals for the day were 6 commits, 0 pull requests, 0 issues and 0 reviews, and no releases were published. No discussions, stars, replies or state changes were recorded, and no section hit its collection cap.
